prompt:
What would be the clinical guidance for someone who is Rapid Metabolizer for CYP2C19 with regards to taking voriconazole?

Answer briefly (under 200 words) with:
1. The guideline recommendation for this specific phenotype (avoid the drug / use an alternative / adjust the dose / standard use / no recommendation).
2. The strength or level of the recommendation, if known.
3. The source (which guideline).

If you have tools available, use them to check before answering. If you cannot determine the answer, say so rather than guessing.

final_answer:
**1. Recommendation:** Use standard-of-care voriconazole dosing, then use therapeutic drug monitoring (TDM) to titrate the dose to target trough concentrations. This is not an "avoid the drug" recommendation. Rapid metabolizers may not reach therapeutic levels with standard dosing, so TDM is central.

**2. Strength:** Moderate, per the CPIC table as summarized in the search results. I could not open the primary table, and my searches returned conflicting snippets on this row, so please confirm the rating in the original.

**3. Source:** CPIC guideline for CYP2C19 and voriconazole therapy (Moriyama et al., 2016/2017). Available at [PubMed 27981572](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/27981572/), [CPIC PDF](https://files.cpicpgx.org/data/guideline/publication/voriconazole/2016/27981572.pdf), and [Clin Pharmacol Ther 2017](https://ascpt.onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1002/cpt.583).

For contrast, the ultrarapid (*17/*17) phenotype gets a different recommendation: an alternative agent not dependent on CYP2C19.

Sources:
- [PubMed: CPIC Guidelines for CYP2C19 and Voriconazole Therapy](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/27981572/)
- [CPIC PDF](https://files.cpicpgx.org/data/guideline/publication/voriconazole/2016/27981572.pdf)
- [Wiley CPT 2017 (Moriyama et al.)](https://ascpt.onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1002/cpt.583)

judge.note_es: La respuesta recomienda voriconazol estándar con TDM (no evitar), contrario a la referencia que indica usar un agente alternativo; además la fuerza 'moderada' y la cita de la guía son dudosas, y la guía CPIC sí recomienda dosis estándar para rápidos en adultos, pero la referencia exige alternativa.
